## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the silver hammer head and claw up and hit the block

Task description: Pick up the hammer near the center of the table, with a silver hammer head and claw, black handle, and yellow end cap, and strike the red block to its right.

Success criteria: The hammer strikes and makes actual contact with the red block, while the designated alignment point on the hammer is approximately above the center of the block's top face. Merely hovering above the block does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the straight section of the black hammer handle near its yellow end, leaving enough contact length for the pads and avoiding the transition at the yellow end. This reduces slipping and leaves room to use the hammer head.
- Close across the hammer handle, with an opening slightly wider than its width. Before closing, confirm the pads are on opposite sides rather than pressing only on the handle surface.
- Adjust the hammer pose where its head is off the table and there is surrounding clearance, orienting the flat striking face toward the top of the block to reduce the risk of the hammer claw or handle contacting the block first.
- Use a shorter striking motion near the block and adjust the horizontal position slightly based on the live view, avoiding scraping its edge or stopping above it without contact.
